description: Apply one change (field values, status and/or published) to many records of a model in a single call: the records named by ids, or every record matching filter with allMatching. Each record is validated, audited and announced to webhooks like update_record. Handles up to 200 records per call; a non-null nextCursor means more records match - pass it back with the same arguments to continue. Returns updated, unchanged (records already at the requested status and visibility, with no data to write), failedCount, a sample of failures (id + reason) and nextCursor.

allMatching.description: Target every record matching filter (all of the model's records when filter is omitted); ignores ids

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to continue the same run

data.description: Field values written to every selected record, keyed by the model's field keys and merged like update_record: fields you don't pass are unchanged, and a translatable field takes a language map whose missing languages are kept.

filter.description: Same grammar as list_records: per key scalar equality, $in, $gte/$lte, $regex; 'status' filters the record status

ids.description: Explicit record ids (from list_records), at most 200

modelIdOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)

published.description: Publish (true) or unpublish (false) every selected record; an unpublished record stays off every public read until published again

status.description: New status for every selected record (validated against the model's statusField transitions)

name: bulk_update_records
title: Bulk update records
